title: CausalSSMContracts
description: Combined JSON Schema for exported artifact contracts and facade API models. Generated from Python Pydantic models.

ActionAttempt.description: A closed action attempt pairs its request with only that action's successful result or failure outcome.

ActionEffects.description: What an executed action did to the store: the workflow installs this.
ActionEffects.title: ActionEffects

ActionMessage.description: A label emitted by an attempt; measurements belong in its scientific result.
ActionMessage.title: ActionMessage

ActionPoll.description: A poll is either running labels or a completed typed attempt with its optional publication identity.

ArtifactEnvelope.description:
An artifact envelope delivers a stored payload with its revision and file
list.
ArtifactEnvelope.title: ArtifactEnvelope

ArtifactFreshness.description: An artifact's presence and freshness are derived from the selected journal revision.

ArtifactId.description: An artifact identity selects one node in the study's artifact graph.

ArtifactRecord.description:
Artifact revision metadata records how a stored artifact was produced and which inputs it
used.

``derived_from`` pins the exact input versions the payload was computed
from. For initial model revisions it is empty. ``created_at`` is
stamped by the activity that produced the revision — never inside workflow
code, where wall-clock time is non-deterministic.
ArtifactRecord.title: ArtifactRecord

AttemptRecord.description: Stored inside the Git object, with no self-referential publication ID.
AttemptRecord.title: AttemptRecord

AttemptTraceIndex.description: Promoted traces identified by their committed execution sequence.
AttemptTraceIndex.title: AttemptTraceIndex

AuthoredLawProvenance.description: The current laws have authored ancestry without retained fitting.
AuthoredLawProvenance.title: AuthoredLawProvenance

BinaryExpression.description: A supported scalar operation composing two expressions.
BinaryExpression.title: BinaryExpression

BinaryOperator.description: A binary operator combines two scalar expression operands.

CallExpression.description: A supported mathematical function, including explicit discrete contrasts.
CallExpression.title: CallExpression

CategoryProbabilitySummary.description: Predictive probabilities for each declared level; unobserved anchors are null.
CategoryProbabilitySummary.title: CategoryProbabilitySummary

CausalEdgeSpec.description: A specification of a directed causal relationship between two constructs.

id.description: Persistent identity. Preserve when revising the same edge.

cause.description: Cause construct; shared endpoints have one identity.

effect.description: Effect construct; shared endpoints have one identity.

description.description: Theoretical justification for this causal link
description.title: Description

sources.description: Literature sources supporting this causal link
sources.title: Sources

CausalEdgeSpec.title: CausalEdgeSpec

CausalEffectResult.description: Causal effects and realized trajectories under the enclosing report's design.
CausalEffectResult.title: CausalEffectResult

ChainDiagnostics.description: Compact retained-chain measurements; plot series compose the report detail.
ChainDiagnostics.title: ChainDiagnostics

CheckGroup.description: A group of model checks is selected by the inputs it consumes.

CoefficientExpression.description: A scientifically typed coefficient operand, literal or parameter reference.

value.description: Fixed coefficients are finite literals; uncertain coefficients reference a persistent parameter ID. Null leaves the operand unassigned.
value.title: Value

construct_ids.description: Additional constructs participating in this coefficient use.
construct_ids.title: Construct Ids

CoefficientExpression.title: CoefficientExpression

CoefficientRole.description: A coefficient role identifies an expression operand’s scientific quantity and support.

CompletedExtractionWorker.description: Retained measurements from a completed worker; no failure field exists.
CompletedExtractionWorker.title: CompletedExtractionWorker

ComputedExtractionSpec.description: Compute a deterministic support-window measurement from source columns.

computed_rule.description: Optional deterministic support-window expression over the declared source columns. It must return one scalar per window with the observation's declared summary operator. Omitted uses a direct single-column aggregation.

fill_null.description: Optional Polars null filling after aggregation on the sorted time grid within the selected data span. Use forward, backward, min, max, mean, zero, one, or a numeric constant. Fills every null, including explicit unknown readings. Omitted leaves nulls unknown. Forward carries the last value and leaves leading nulls unknown.

fill_null_limit.title: Fill Null Limit

ConstructRef.description:

id.description: Persistent identity. Preserve when revising or renaming.

distribution.description: Membership in a trajectory law in ModelSpec.distributions on ModelSpec.time_points.

role.description: 'endogenous' means modeled, with or without parents; 'exogenous' means given through direct exact readings, with no law. Unmeasured constructs are endogenous.

treatments.title: Treatments

StudyRevision.description: Git publication wraps its already-owned record, without copying its fields.
StudyRevision.title: StudyRevision

StudyState.description:
Study state projects the artifact trees selected by one Git commit.

``current`` maps artifact id → the revision info that is *current* for the
study. Absent key = the artifact does not exist (either never produced,
or produced-when-nonempty semantics withheld it).
StudyState.title: StudyState

StudyStatus.description: Study status reports committed artifacts, their freshness, actions, and any running one.
StudyStatus.title: StudyStatus

SummaryOperator.description:
A summary operator specifies how values within a measurement window produce one
observation.
SummaryOperator.title: SummaryOperator

TemperingDiagnostics.description: Retained tempering telemetry, separate from evidence of a production engine.
TemperingDiagnostics.title: TemperingDiagnostics

TemporalStatus.description: Temporal status states whether a construct varies within the individual over time.
TemporalStatus.title: TemporalStatus

TimelineResponse.description: Typed attempt journal returned by the study read plane.
TimelineResponse.title: TimelineResponse

TraceMessage.description:
A trace message records one conversational step, including any reasoning or tool
interaction.

TraceSeries.description: Every retained draw, grouped in original chain order.

TraceToolCall.description: A function invocation with the call identity used to match its result.
TraceToolCall.title: TraceToolCall

TraceUsage.description: Trace usage records the input, output, and reasoning tokens consumed by a conversation.

ValidationIssue.description:
A validation issue explains a data problem and its severity for an indicator or the
dataset.

indicator_id.description: Affected indicator; null for a dataset-wide issue.

ValidationIssue.title: ValidationIssue

ValidationReportArtifact.description: Data findings composed with model-dependent execution checks.

is_valid.description: Whether both the data findings and model preflight contain no failures.
is_valid.title: Is Valid

ValidationReportArtifact.title: ValidationReportArtifact

WindowExpression.description: Deterministic support-window expression that returns one scalar per window. Use Python-like syntax over source_columns with arithmetic, comparisons, if/else, and helper functions such as any(), sum(), mean(), std(), first(), last(), count_true(), count_non_null(), lower(), contains(), and contains_any(). Use None for missing values.

ActionEffects.description: What an executed action did to the store: the workflow installs this.
ActionEffects.title: ActionEffects

ArtifactRecord.description:
Artifact revision metadata records how a stored artifact was produced and which inputs it
used.

``derived_from`` pins the exact input versions the payload was computed
from. For initial model revisions it is empty. ``created_at`` is
stamped by the activity that produced the revision — never inside workflow
code, where wall-clock time is non-deterministic.
ArtifactRecord.title: ArtifactRecord

AuthoredLawProvenance.description: The current laws have authored ancestry without retained fitting.
AuthoredLawProvenance.title: AuthoredLawProvenance

ConstructRef.description:
A construct reference identifies a construct independently of its current name or
revision.

EdgeRef.description:
An edge reference identifies a causal relationship independently of edits to its
definition.
EdgeRef.title: EdgeRef

EvaluatedPredictiveChecks.description: An evaluated run may retain failed and partially unavailable scientific evidence.
EvaluatedPredictiveChecks.title: EvaluatedPredictiveChecks

FittedLawProvenance.description: All current laws retain one committed fit's model and observation panel.
FittedLawProvenance.title: FittedLawProvenance

HistogramBin.description: A histogram bin gives its interval, center, and number of posterior draws.
HistogramBin.title: HistogramBin

revision.

MixedLawProvenance.description: Some laws retain a committed fit and others have different ancestry.

PPCOverlay.description:
A predictive overlay sets one indicator's observed values against simulated ones.

It carries the predictive median and a few individual replicated series, the
spaghetti plot of a visual predictive check.
PPCOverlay.title: PPCOverlay

PPCTestStat.description:
A predictive test statistic compares an observed summary with its distribution under
replicated data.

Provides the data for Gabry's ppc_stat plots: histogram of T(y_rep)
with a vertical line at T(y_observed).
PPCTestStat.title: PPCTestStat

id.description: Persistent identity. Preserve when revising or renaming.

aggregation.description: Aggregation function applied when bucketing raw extractions within the indicator support window. Supported operators: first, last, sum, count, mean, std. A computed_rule must produce this same summary.

observation_window.description: Optional duration string describing the support window summarized by this indicator, in positive fixed units s, m, h, d or w (for example '2w'). Resolved by the preparation window or the generative model clock.
observation_window.title: Observation Window

ordinal_levels.description: Ordered list of level labels from lowest to highest for ordinal indicators (e.g., ['low', 'medium', 'high']). Required when measurement_dtype='ordinal' to ensure correct numeric encoding.
ordinal_levels.title: Ordinal Levels

categorical_levels.description: Exhaustive list of level labels for categorical indicators (e.g., ['home', 'work', 'other']). Required when measurement_dtype='categorical' to ensure correct numeric encoding.
categorical_levels.title: Categorical Levels

FactSource.description: A fact source locates supporting content within an artifact revision and records its freshness.
FactSource.title: FactSource

GitRef.description: An exact file in a study's Git object database: repository, object, and path.
GitRef.title: GitRef

SourceValidity.description: Whether a selected artifact still matches its pinned inputs.
SourceValidity.title: SourceValidity
